Results.ReviewText: This was my first gas grill, and I've been using it for about six years. Only problem has been a couple of small grease fires, and those were my fault. Would definitely buy another Weber.
Results.Title: Easy to use

Results.ReviewText:
The grill is just what I expected from Weber. I like the 4 caster model so it can be moved easily.
I bought the Weber cover but am disappointed. It is much flimsier than the previous one from my old grill. I don’t expect it to last as long as my other cover.
Results.Title: Great grill but poor cover.

Results.ReviewText: Nice, sturdy grill And the reason I bought Weber was due to the fact that in the future as things start to deteriorate on it (is outside all the time, with a cover) that parts for it are available all the time. Prior to this I used to buy just really cheap ones which lasted a few years and then bought another one. I gave it for stars due to the fact I wish that The BTU output. was a little bit higher to get a better sear on steaks
Results.Title: Very nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Weber because I had one for over 12 years and my wife thought it about time we invest in a new one, we gave our old one to the neighbor.  What else needs to be said.  They last forever.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has all the features along with the perfect size to handle my needs. The BTU output esceed my expectations and I would recommend this grill.

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill about three weeks ago, and have used it half a dozen times for various types of meat.  I absolutely love it.  No complaints at all.  It takes some time to get used to maintaining the temperatures you want to cook with, but I have a handle on it after only a few uses.

Results.ReviewText: This is actually a good little grill. The regulator hose that came with was defective. It has a leak right behind where it attaches to the propane tank and the regulator. Results.ReviewText:
Fairly easy to assemble. It took about an hour to put together. When assembled this is a very solid unit. 

The grill is perfect size for my needs. It would easily handle room for 4 or 5 steaks or chicken quarters. 

My experience with Weber products has always been good. This grill is no exception, I believe it will be is regular use for the next 10 years
Results.Title: Perfect for me.

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill. It is compact, good looking and I think it will survive the challenge of its ocean front location. My only problem is one that has been mentioned before in reviews I read before buying. I have yet to try to load a full propane tank on the device that measures the amount of gas left in the tank.
Results.Title: New E-210 Grill on the ocean

Results.ReviewText: I owed a weber grill back in the 90's so this is my second one.  I am very pleased with the grill ,but have one complaint.. the tank sits on the deck and it is very difficult to roll and move even though the grill has wheels... it seems to me the design should include a holder or cradle to keep the tank off the ground thus making it easy to maneuver ...all of my other grills had this type of design..IS THERE AN ACCESSORY I CAN GET TO CORRECT THIS ISSUE????
Results.Title: HAPPY WITH RESERVATIONS

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this! You should not have to disconnect and connect your propane tank in order to start your grill. Make sure that you are turning off and closing your tank after every use. When starting your grill be sure to push your control knobs all the way in and then turn. If you continue to have issues with your grill, be sure to reach out to our support team! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill ~2 months ago and use it ~2-3 times per week. About 30% of the time the grill has difficulty starting, and the only thing that helps is disconnecting the grill from the propane & reconnecting it. I thought it was the propane tank, but the same thing kept happening when we used a 2nd tank. Overall, the grill is good when it works, but it's frustrating when it has difficulty starting.
Results.Title: Difficulty starting, good when working

Results.ReviewText: I've always wanted a Weber Gas grill. I have had a number of Weber Kettle grills over the years. My folks have had Weber's for years and I always liked the way they cook. Very easy to clean and never had any problems finding parts for standard maintenance. There are many has grills out there but nothing cooks like a Weber.
Results.Title: Nothing like a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love my new E-210 Spirit grill. It’s well made and easy to use.  The grates are solid and the electric start works well.
Results.Title: A Work Horse

Results.ReviewText: Great built product. Assembly not difficult and love the fold down shelf on each side.
Results.Title: Great product.

Results.ReviewText: I've had this grill since 2014 and it has taken a beating. Hadn't used it in a while and thought about replacing, but I used this quarantine to spend a couple hours doing a thorough cleaning of it and replacing a few small parts. The result has been fantastic - it's like having a brand new grill again. Really heats up well! New proclean flavorizer bars are also a game changer. I love this grill - it's gotten me through my 20s and I look forward to getting through my 30s with it feeding my little family.
Results.Title: Built to Last

Results.ReviewText: All my life I loved to grill until about two years ago when I got tired of my previous larger unit. I have rediscovered grilling after the recent purchase of my new Spirit E-210 gas grill. In short order, I've had delicious steaks, chicken, pork and fish cooked to perfection. This was after starting with simple hamburgers, hotdogs and sausages that were the first meal prepared. The size of the grill is fairly small, but works well for my wife and I. It fits in a hidden nook on my back deck. Easy to keep clean, I look forward to many years of enjoyment.
Results.Title: Rediscovered grilling

Results.ReviewText: Replaced a 3 year old grill that was rusting I and couldn’t be happier with my new Weber purchase. The Spirit E-210 is so much better than my previous grill. This is the perfect size for my family.
Results.Title: Great gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Everything's built to last and the warranty"s excellent.
Results.Title: Fire it up !!

Results.ReviewText: The best grill I have ever purchased. Starting and cleaning so easy.
Results.Title: The best

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food.
